title: Start a fresh session
text: Start with a fresh session, then run the baseline.
lines: Set the sample count, then click Run.
This creates the baseline without evidence.

title: Choose the decision task
text: Choose bridge inspection to prioritise people's access to key destinations.
lines: The objective is access to key destinations.

title: Calculating priorities
text: The initial priorities are calculated. Waiting time is shortened here.

title: A task that stays active
text: The active task updates its priorities as new observations arrive.

title: Enter an observation
text: For this example, enter a ground-motion reading of zero point zero five g at bridge e seventy-three.
speech: For this example, enter a ground motion reading of zero point zero five gee at bridge E seventy-three.

title: Build the evidence base
text: Add the observation to update the model and the inspection priorities.
lines: The model and priorities update together.

title: Updating with evidence
text: The observation is being incorporated. Waiting time is shortened here.
lines: Waiting time is shortened in this clip.

title: Evidence is now recorded
text: The reading is now in the evidence base. Next, check the results in Roadmap and the Bayesian network.
lines: The evidence base keeps the reading.
